info.name: Autonomous AP APIs Chart of Accounts Lookup Table API

items.docs: Returns the list of Lookup Tables

Creates a new Lookup Table. Returns a uuid for this lookup table.
When there already exists a lookup table (with the same lookup_name_id), then the operation is an update (in this case, the `status` in the response will be `UPDATED`).
